title: Worms After Rain
author: Ty_
rules:
Sudoku

Each row, column, and region must contain the digits 1-9 once each.

Disjoint Groups

Cells in the same position within the boxes cannot contain the same digit.

Thermometers

Digits along a Thermometer must increase as they move away from the bulb.

Play this puzzle on SudokuBank
solutionCode: Digits in row 2 and digits in row 5, without spaces (18 digits).
